feature1.title: Voice tasks on WhatsApp
feature1.text: Speak and done, your voice notes become tasks with WhatsApp reminders so you don't miss a thing.

feature2.title: Smart daily plan
feature2.text: Eureky builds your agenda with priorities and syncs with Google, Apple or Microsoft Calendar. It tells you what to do now and when.

feature3.title: Smart nudges + Reviews
feature3.text: If you postpone, Eureky reschedules the task, motivates you and shows your progress in daily, weekly or monthly reviews.

feature4.title: Capture voice, text or images
feature4.text: Add tasks by text, voice or with photos and documents; Eureky understands it and schedules it instantly.

1.question: What is Eureky.ai and how does it help me achieve my goals?
1.answer: Eureky.ai is your personal productivity assistant that helps you organize your tasks, set reminders and achieve your goals efficiently.

2.question: Can I schedule recurring reminders?
2.answer: Yes, you can schedule daily, weekly or monthly recurring reminders according to your needs.

3.question: What unique features does Eureky.ai have?
3.answer: Eureky.ai offers features like voice capture, image analysis, calendar synchronization, AI copilot and much more.

4.question: Is my information secure?
4.answer: Yes, your information is completely secure. We use end-to-end encryption and never share your data with third parties.
